column3: Commission for Truth, Unity and Reconciliation
NOW THEREFORE, BE it enacted by the Parliament of the
Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1.(1) This Act may be cited as the Commission for Truth,
Unity and Reconciliation in Sri Lanka Act, No.    of 2024.
(2) The provisions of this Act, other than this section shall
come into operation on the date of expiration of two months
from the date on which this Bill becomes an Act of Parliament.
(3) The provisions of this section shall come into operation
on the date on which this Bill becomes an Act of Parliament.
